en: Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a large, grand hotel complex with multiple wings and corner towers standing on a forested hill. In the foreground, dense trees cover the slope. On the left, a steep hillside funicular railway with two cars ascends to a covered upper station near the hotel. In the lower right corner, partly hidden by foliage, is a small classical pavilion with a domed roof and columns, likely over a spring or viewpoint. The scene is mountainous/rolling countryside. No printed or handwritten text is visible on the image.
